description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of the NotesSyncService interface, allowing notes to be synchronized via a simple in-memory store mimicking remote server behavior. It includes methods for pushing and pulling notes based on update timestamps.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesSyncService
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the NotesSyncService interface that stores notes in a HashMap to simulate a remote backend, supports pushing and pulling notes with timestamp filtering.

methods.name: InMemoryNotesSyncService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a Clock instance.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Stores a list of notes into the in-memory remote store, updating existing notes by ID.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes updated since a given timestamp, filtering the remote store based on note.updatedAt.
